name: seo-report
summary: Produce a complete Markdown report from approved SEO evidence with source labels, limitations, next actions, and no unsupported business claims.
inputs: client/project/site, period, market/language/device, included workflows, approved evidence bundle, output path, neutral/client-brand mode
external_reads: approved existing evidence only; live reads require approval
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live external reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context and approved report paths
external_mutation: CMS, analytics, provider, code, SEO, and production mutations are out of scope
done_when: scope, period, evidence cutoff, source labels, freshness, limitations, and skipped sections are visible
facts, interpretations, recommendations, assumptions, and unknowns are separated
no unsupported business or performance guarantee exists
owners, approvals, dependencies, statuses, and rechecks are explicit where applicable
Markdown is the source of truth; presentation output does not add findings
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify no imported promotional language remains
verify no invented data, sources, dates, owners, budgets, approvals, or outcomes
verify optional presentation output adds no findings
